avis.texte: This is incredibly hydrating and lush without being too heavy or sticky. Definitely recommend for aging skin.

I love Lancôme's Renergie Multi-Action face cream, so i was excited to try this Peptide Cream. I tried it at night on its own first. In the morning, my skin was ITCHING so badly and there were large RED BUMPS (about 7!) Yikes! It took over a week to clear up. If you have sensitive skin and want to try this, I recommend buying the travel size first - or better yet, a sample size.

avis.titre: Only a Sample, But Love it So Far! Definitely Firming!
avis.texte: I only got a trial/sample size. So I was only able to use it for about a week. But so far I actually really love it. In only a week I absolutely do feel like my face is firmer. I don't notice any other antiaging benefits, other than that. But like I said, I've only been using it for a week. I like that my face feels very hydrated and moisturized after using it. And the moisture seems to last for a pretty long time. Not as long as some other moisturizers I've tried, though. That's part of why I only gave it four stars. The other reason why I only gave it four stars is it does have a very strong fragrance to it. It's not bad, I don't mind it very much. But it can be kind of overwhelming sometimes and especially if people do not like strong fragrances in their skincare, I would not recommend this product. But overall, after using it for a week, I really like it, and I look forward to purchasing a large container of it to try out for a longer time period. I also gave it a four instead of a five, just because it's very expensive, and I rarely see sales on this brand.
This is a product my mother uses for her face on a regular basis so I buy it for her and she loves it. She looks so useful she's 89 years old and she's still going strong.

I just purchased my second jar of this cream. I like it very much but do not see what it actually did for my skin. Unfortunately I have a weakness for buying products when they are on sale and this was 50 percent off. After I am finished with this jar I think I am going to try Loreal Paris products and see if there really is a difference or am I paying for the name and packaging. All in all I like the texture of the cream goes on wonderfully and does make my face soft.
Love this product and the trip made better when the rep was present. Love her

avis.titre: Be careful!  This cream comes SPF and no SPF

I will always look for the best sales and discounts but if I would pay full price because this moisturizer is magic and now a permanent staple in my skincare routine and I HIGHLY recommend this for all women my age and up in need of help fighting fine lines and wrinkles and skin elasticity.
